w, m = map(int, input().split())

if w <= 3:
    print("YES")
    exit()

nDigits = 0
power = 1
bases = []

while power <= 2000000000:
    bases.append(power)
    power *= w
    nDigits += 1

counts = [-1] * nDigits
sum_bases = -sum(bases)
found = False

while True:
    index = 0
    while True:
        counts[index] += 1
        sum_bases += bases[index]
        if counts[index] != 2:
            if abs(sum_bases) == m:
                found = True
            break
        counts[index] = -1
        sum_bases -= 3 * bases[index]
        index += 1
        if index == nDigits:
            break
    if index == nDigits:
        break

print("YES" if found else "NO")
</translated_code>
